Honest Reviews Of Good Food

Exploring Minnesota One Bite at a Time

Minnesota is home to incredible food, from iconic local dishes to hidden gems waiting to be discovered. But great food is more than just flavor—it’s about the people who make it, the places that serve it, and the stories that bring it all to life.

What You’ll Find on Our Website

  • Restaurant & Food Directory: Search by location, cuisine, or must-try dishes to find your next favorite spot.
  • Reviews & Recommendations: Honest insights into local favorites, hidden gems, and can’t-miss dining experiences.
  • Food Stories & Features: Deep dives into Minnesota’s culinary traditions, emerging trends, and behind-the-scenes looks at the industry.
  • Interviews & Conversations: Meet the chefs, food artisans, and restaurant owners shaping the state’s food culture through stories, videos, and yes—a podcast.

Featured Must-Try Dishes

Discover Minnesota’s most iconic and underrated eats. From local favorites to hidden gems, these dishes are worth the trip!

Treasury of Pine River Rueben

The Treasury of Pine River has the Rueben on Lockdown. This is a fabled existence. The mythical 3+ hour drive is easily the price we’d pay to eat this sandwich again. It’s only available for 3 hrs a day, one day a week. The corned beef is tender, lightly smoked, and incredible in ways I can’t adequately describe. The perfect toast on the rye bread, tartness of the sauerkraut, and creaminess provided by the Swiss cheese is an orchestra on my tastebuds. Definitely on the top of the list for Ruebens.

5-8 Club Juicy Lucy Burger

Pretty darn good burger! Fresh baked bun, juicy patty filled with and topped with cheese. Finished with bacon, 5-8 sauce, and an onion ring made this burger one of my more delightful experiences. While the burger was great, the star of the show, was marshmellow blue cheese dipping sauce for the sweet potatoe fries. Excellent service and average prices make this burger stop, a 1+ hour drive worthy venture. Bring a friend, burgers always taste better when you have good company.
